title: SURE agent spec (agent.yaml)
description: Declarative definition of an Agent under evaluation: an input->output contract plus an ordered chain of stages, each stage naming an approved model. YAML, validated by scripts/agent_spec.py.

name.description: Agent identifier; used in the product directory name.

task.description: Agent task id, e.g. s2tt (speech-to-text translation). AST is S2TT.

stages.description: Stages run in declaration order; the previous stage's text output feeds the next stage.

id.description: Stage identifier, unique within the spec.

model.description: Exact approved model directory name below storage.approved_models_roots[0]. No aliases or paths.

prompt_template.description: Optional prompt template for LLM (API-mode) stages. Placeholders: {text}, {target_language}, {source_language}, {dataset}, {key}.
